(7)༄༅/ /ḍom+bhi he ru kas mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (7)༄༅// ḍom+bhi he ru kas mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ (8)༄༅// na mo gu ru ḍom+bhi he ru ka /de la ḍom+bhi he ru kas/ lung las/ lhan cig skyes par gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya// rang bzhin lhan cig rten la sems nyid gnyug ma skyes shes brjod// rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /ces pa la brten nas/ ḍom+bhi pas lhan cig skyes grub bshad/ de'i don nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag ni 'di yin te/ rgyu lhan cig skyes pa/ thabs lhan cig skyes pa/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'o// de ltar na lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de yang don 'di ltar gsungs te/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang mngon tu byed par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag la lam sgrub tshul gnyis te dka' thub kyi rtog bcas lam dang*/ bu chung gi lam rtog med gnyis yin te/ de gnyis ka la'ang chud ma zos pa rnam pa gsum dgos/ longs spyod chud ma zos pa/ lus chud ma zos pa/ sems chud ma zos pa'o// de yang dang po ni/ zang zing longs spyod yod na me dang chu dang dgra dang gdon gang gis kyang chud ma zos par byas la/ dang por bla ma la btang*/ de nas dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro ma la gtang*/ rgyu med na blos lam gnyis ka la thun mong du 'gro gtang ngo*/ longs spyod chud ma zos pa'o// lus chud ma zos pa ni/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ste/ so sor thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'o// de re re la'ang phyi'i sdom (9)pa dang*/ nang gi sdom pa gnyis gnyis so// de la phyi'i so sor thar pa ni/ dge bsnyen gyi bsrung bya rnam pa lnga// dge tshul gyi yang dag par blang ba bcu gsum/ dge slong gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mo// nang gi thig le mi nyams par lus la gnas pa nyid do// byang chub sems dpa'i phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi'i ni pham pa'i chos bzhi dang nyes byas sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa'o// nang gi sdug bsngal can la snying rje chen pos kun nas slongs te/

sems can gyi don snying rjes byed pa dang*/ shes pa gsal cha ma 'gags pa/ lus ci rigs su bkol ba nyid do// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa la phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi ni rgyud sde rnams las thun mong du grags pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad de nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba'o// nang gi shes pa gnyug ma mi rtog par gnas pa'o// de ltar na phyi'i sdom pa gsum ni/ dka' thub kyi lam du 'gyur la/ nang gi sdom pa gsum gyis ni/ bu chung gi mi rtog pa'i lam du 'gyur ro// lus chud ma zos pa'o// sems chud ma zos pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis/ de la phyi ni kun rdzob smon 'jug /don dam spros bral lo// nang ni kun rdzob kun+da/ don dam bde stong ngo*// de yang phyi ni dka' thub kyi lam/ nang ni bu chung gi lam mo// sems chud ma zos pa'o// gsum dang ldan pa'i (10)steng du thabs gsum gsum du bsten na 'bras bu sku gsum du 'char ro// de la lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyi lam khrid lugs ni 'di yin te/ rgyu lhan cig skyes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas pa dang*/ thabs lhan cig skyes pa nyams gsum skye ba'i thabs dang*/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ sku gsum 'char ba'o// de la rgyu lhan cig skyes pa la shes pas chog lta ba chos bco lngas bstan te/ lus la rtsa gsum lhan cig skyes/ ngag rlung ldang 'jug gnas pa gsum lhan cig skyes/ sems nyon mongs pa dug gsum du lhan cig skyes chos dgu/ lhan cig skyes pa de la nang gi bar chad nang 'du ba gsum lhan skyes/ phyi'i bar chad gdon gsum lhan cig skyes/ de la nang rlung dang gcig /khrag mkhris gnyis gcig tu bya/ bad kan dang gsum mo// gdon gsum ni/ pho rigs mo rigs/ klu rigs gsum mo// de la chos bco lnga ni/ de la dang po thog mar lus grub pa nas bzung nas chos bco lnga lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir/

lhan cig skyes pa'o// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lugs 'di'i/ sems nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs skye med lhan skyes dang po'o// thabs lhan cig skyes pa gang zag rigs gnyis kyi thabs kyang gnyis te/ dka' thub pa'i gang zag de lam du zhugs nas/ dang por bla ma spyi bor dran cing byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgom/ lha'i rnal 'byor yid tsam gyis dran par bya/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor lag len bzhin bya/ ngag 'dren pa lugs gnyis la yan lag gsum gsum du bya ba bla ma'i zhal las dri/ nyams kyi man ngag chos nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bu chung gi lam dang thun mong du bstan/ bu chung gi lam pa yin na/ phyag rgya la rab 'bring gsum du phye ba'i tha ma yang*/ rab 'bring gnyis gang rnyed la sngar gyi chos gsum po sngon du song nas zla ba gcig ngag 'dren pa rgyun mi 'chad du mdangs sgrub ngo dmar ting song song du/ lus ngag gi 'khrul 'khor snga ma bzhin bya/ de nas 'du shes gsum pad+ma pa dang barbi pa (11)bzhin byas la phyag rgya brten to// zhag dang po nas bcu gcig tshun chad du bde bas brgyal nas mi 'gro mi srid do// dka' thub dang bu chung gi lam gnyis ka la gang zag la la bde bas brgyal nas 'gro ba yang yod do// de la dang po nyams 'di 'char te/ thur sel gyen la log pa'i stobs kyis lus la bde rlung 'bar/ drod dang bde ba dus gcig tu skye/ sems dga' bde skye/ ngag rgod pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ glo bur gyi 'o dod 'bod de/ de ltar lus skye ba'i go rim nges pa med ngag yid gsum car la 'dod chags chen pos khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ brtan pa'i go rim/ /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags lam du slong ba yin pas yul gyi chags pa rim gyis spang ngo*// nad rlung nad rim gyis 'byong 'byung ngo*/ gdon mo rigs las grol lo// lus rtsa g.yon pa dbang du 'dus pa'o// rmi lam du yang bde ba 'byung ngo*// rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'i ming thob bo// de ltar brgyad de yan lag dang po'o/

rgyu nyid lam du 'gyur ba'o lnga tshan dang pos // gnyis pa thur sel 'dren pa rnam gnyis 'dra/ nyams myong cig car du skye/ yang bde ba skyes pa'i dus su shes pa gsal ba yang ba 'dzin rtog grol/ snying rje chen po 'byung ba ting nge 'dzin/ gsal ba mthar thug pa ni zhe sdang yin pas zhe sdang lam du 'gyur te// mi sdug pa'i rkyen gyis gsal ba mthar thug skye'o// nad khrag mkhris gnyis zhi/ gdon pho rigs las grol lo// lus kyi rtsa ro ma dbang du 'dus/ ngag phyir 'byung ba dbang du 'dus// sems rmi lam du'ang nam mkha' la skyil krung bcas pa la sogs pa gsal zhing yang ba 'byung*/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa gzungs rtog grol/ zhes bya'i ming thob bo// de ltar brgyad do// de rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i mthus so// gsum pa ni yang thur sel 'dren pa rnam gnyis kyi mthus// snga ma dang cig car du shes pa rang bzhin gnyug ma mi rtog pa mchog tu gyur (12)pa 'byung ngo*// ting nge 'dzin to// yul gang la'ang mi rtog pas ma rig pa chen po yin te/ nyon mongs pa gti mug lam du slongs so// nad bad kan las rim gyis grol lo// gdon klu'i rigs kyis mi tshugs so// lus kyi rtsa kun+da ra dbang du 'dus so// ngag rlung gnas pa la dbang thob bo// sems mi rtog pa la mnyam rjes med/ gnyid log ma log med de/ gnyid log sad ba mi 'byed pa'o// rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid ces ming thob bo// de ltar brgyad do// de'ang rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i mthus so// de ltar yan lag nyi shu rtsa gnyis lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams skyed do// da ni 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa las dang por rtags 'byung ste/ gzungs 'dzin gnyis ka las grol lo/ nyams gsum rgyud las skyes pa yin na/ lus kyi gzhan don byed pa'i khyad par nad dang gdon gyis than pa'i sdug bsngal can mthong na// lus kyis byugs pa tsam gyis zhi ba la sogs pa 'byung*/

'gom pa dang dri chen dang dri chu lus la byugs pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal la sogs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// ngag gzhan don byed pa'i khyad par gyi rtags ni/ nad sos par gyur cig ces byas pas nad la sogs pa dang*// rims nad zhi ba la sogs pa tshig gi mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro// sems kyi rtags dang por rmi lam gsal por 'byung*/ de nas mi ma yin pa mthong bar 'byung*/ des na sgom nyams nyid la phan pa dang gnod pa shes par 'byung ngo*// yang rtags gsum ste/ lus 'di nyid la 'char ba'i rtags// 'chi khar 'char ba'i rtags so// bar dor 'char ba'i rtags// 'di nyid kyi rtags ni/ lus yang*/ mdangs bzang*/ zas la zhen pa chung*/ gang la yang zhen pa chung*/ bya ba gang la'ang thug phrad tsam byed brjed ngas// blo bur du dran pa skye/ de tsam mo// 'chi khar ni gnad gcod pa'i zug med/ 'chi ba la 'jigs pa med/ lha mi'i lus len pa la don gnyer ba med/ rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams dang ma bral tsam 'byung ngo*// (13)bar do'i rtags ni/ bar dor bla ma dang mjal ba snyam byed/ sangs rgyas zhal mthong ba snyam byed/ lus kyang gang gi len pa de'i snang ba yang rang gi lhag pa'i lhar 'char ste/ bar do rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs 'gyur ro// tshe rabs thams cad kyi ngan song gi sgo khegs so// de yang lus 'di nyid kyis rtags byung na/ 'chi kha ma'i rtags mi 'byung mi srid do// 'di'i lugs kyi rtags dang po cung zad tsam byung na/ gsang ba'i spyod pa rim gyis byed pa yin te/ spyod pa'i dus la rig pa krig ge ba zhig mi bzhed/ rnam rtog chung chung 'dra na dri chen dang dri chu yang rim gyis gsang la bsten/ sha chen yang bsten/ gos bzang ngan med par bgo /grogs kyang rigs bzang ba dang ngan pa gnyis ka la bsgrod// gtso bo mtshan mo yin/ nyin mo grogs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa bya/ 'jig rten kha na ma tho ba bsrung*/ de ltar gsang ba'i spyod pa rim gyis spyad na sems nyams brtan zhing rtags gsum la sogs pa myur du 'char ro// mngon shes 'char zhing gzhan don nus na rgyan drug gdags te brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya bar bzhed do// 'di'i lugs la lam dang po bsgom pa nas bzung ste/

'bras bu thob pa'i bar du bar chad kyi chos gud du bsal ba mi bzhed de/ bar chad ni nad gsum// gdon gsum drug yin la/ de ni nyams bskyangs pa nyid kyis rang grol du bzhed do/ dang po chos sku ni rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag gcig ste/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'o// de ni lam tha ma rnams kyis 'grub pa yin no// longs sku ni yan lag gsum ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang*/ kha sbyor gyi yum dang bcas pa/ bde chen gyi zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ba'o// lam dang po rnams kyis 'grub pa yin no// sprul sku la yan lag gsum ste/ snying rjes nges par gang ba'i yan lag ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying (14)rje chen po rtog pa med kyang sems can gyi don byed pa'i rgyu yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'o// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag ni/ gdul bya gnas pa de srid kyi bar du sprul pa'i rgyun mi 'chad de/ chu snod dang zla ba'i dpes so// 'di ni sgrub pa po dngos kyi yan lag go /'gog pa med pa'i yan lag ni/ don gyi sprul pa'i sku la mya ngan las 'da' ba med par bzhed do// tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang bcu las tshe la dbang ba zhes bya ba'i phyir te/ dgag pa'i ngos kyi yan lag go /lam bar pa rnams kyis 'grub pa yin no// de ltar sku gsum 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'o// bsdu na rgyu lnga tshan gsum / lam lam brgyad tshan / 'bras bu sku gsum gsum la gsum gsum dbye ba tsam mo// sa mā sta mi thi/ ༈ sbyor bu chung rtog med kyi dbang du byas na ba'i yum bzhi la/ pad+ma can la rigs gsum ste/ rab bde ba skye ba'i rgyu kyi bya dkar la rtsa dmar ba/ lus rags pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ spyir lus po phra la/ khyad par sked pa phra ba/ bya ltar rkang lag dmar ba/ so legs pa/

de ni de bzhin te/ mtshan dang ldan pa ste rigs/ bu chung rtog med kyi dbang du byas na/ shin tu bzang po'o// de bde ba skye ba'i rgyu la sbyar na rgyal ba'i 'bras bu tshe 'di nyid mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam pa bde ba skye ba'i rkyen la thob bo// 'bring ni sha rtsi dkar ba/ rus khyim che ba/ rus pa rags pa/ khong brdal che ba/ spyod lam rtsing ba/ gshin rje'i gshed rtog pa dang*/ byad sdug pa/ blo bcos dka' ba/ sgrub pa dang bstun/ bu skye na khye'u skye ba/ 'jig rten gyi las dang bya ba la mkhas pa/ de dang rtsa 'phrad na lo mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam pa bde ba skye ba'i rkyen/ mi thogs par 'bras bu thob bo// tha ma dkar po smin sgyur ma zhes bya ste/ kha dog dkar ba/ byad legs kyang snying du de snyed mi sdug pa/ gsang mi thub pa/ gzugs byad ches pa/ byi dor la brtson pa/ rgod kha yang ba/ mig 'phyar ba/ bslu sla ba skyes pa gang gis kyang*/ bslu kha na yang ba ste/ de ni bsten dngos grub kyi gnas su gyur pa rigs ma yin (15)no// dung can ma ni/ sha ser la rtsa dmar ba/ spyod khyer mkhas pa/ 'dug tshugs legs pa/ tshig brtan pa/ mig zur mig tu blta ba/ zur rno ba/ don gang la'ang bag tsam gyis go ba/ shes rab che ba/ de lta bu dang 'phrad na tshe 'di la 'bras bu thob bo// 'bring ni rgyab nas bltas na dgye ba snyam byed pa/ mdun nas bltas na sgrub snyam byed pa/ spyir lus legs pa/ khyad par du smin phrag gi mtshams legs pa/ rdom chung ba/ khrom du phyin na byad bying bying byed pa/ byad kyi gzod chung ba/ ko kos brang las phyir dgye ba snyoms 'jug byas ba dang*/ shin tu snying nye ba/ gdung skyes pa gzhan mi 'dod pa de dang rtsa 'byor na lo zlar mi thog par ro// tha ma ni sha ser ba/ mig 'bor che ba/ blo rno ba/ dran pa gsal ba/ 'dug mi tshugs shing 'gro 'dug mang ba/ 'phral du lag pas kyang mi tshugs pa/

tshigs mi brtan pa/ chad pa la blo gtad med pa/ ci la yang gzhung ngan pa/ skyes pa mig la 'tsho ba/ snying du sdug pa'i mi la bya ra thang nge byed pa de mi bsten no/ ri mo can pa ni/ sha rtsi sngo ba/ byad dkyus ring ba/ mchu'i skor che ba cung zhig sbom pa/ gnyer ma mang ba/ mig legs pa/ skad snyan pa/ zhi des dul che gzhung bzang ba/ spyod pa 'jam pa/ mi chos dang lha chos kyi phyogs nas 'dris pa la zhe sa che ba gzhung bzang ba/ bkra shis pa'i yan lag bar chad 'byung bas/ mang ba/ de nyid la dngos grub nye ba/ yo byad dang*/ ༈༈༈'ong ngo 'bring tshad lo// tha ma sha rtsi gnag pa/ dpral ba sa re/ mig chung ba/ ming gting na 'dug pa/ 'dum kha yang ba/ skyes sgrub pa po'i longs spyod che la phan pa/ pa la dad che ba mi bsten no// ba glang can ma rab ni/ smin phrag ring ba'am yangs pa/ lus mi ring ba/ kha dog dal ba/ spyod lam dal ba/ dam dam

skyes pa la 'khyud pa la sogs pa mi byed pa/ reg reg mi shes pa/ ci yang lhod de bar sdod pa/ dbang che bar 'ong nges pa/ de dang 'byor na dbu ma yin pa yang bde ba skye ba'i (16)ba'i rtsa mang po yod/ mang bas bkra shis pa'i rgyu mang ba ste bsten par bya'o// 'bring ni/ khog shes che ba/ byad rdom mang po 'tshogs na zhing bzang che ba/ gdong pa zheng che ba/ lus khyim legs pa/ slur mi btub pa/ nor gsog mkhas pa/ don mi 'chor zhing mdo che ba/ mi 'phro ba/ spro ring ba bsten par dung ngo*// tha ma ni/ lus kyi spyod lam dang*/ tshig mtho dman mang po la gtad sa med pa/ smra ba/ he rta ma col chung ba zhes bya ste/ smra 'dod pa/ rdzun che ba/ khro yang sla/ dga' yang sla/ tshig mtho dman che ba/ mgu sla ba/ steng la mi dga' ba/ gtor ba chung ba sgrub po la bar chad byed pas de bsten du mi rung ngo*// za ma bzhi ma gtogs pa gzhan rnyed pa rtsa birba pa dang 'dra btsal lo/ rtsa rnyed na gces dgu thams cad rgyab tu bskyur la rlung la goms ngag brten par bya zhing*/ thig kha zas kyis les lus rgyas par byas la lhan cig skyes pa'i don la mngon du phyogs par gyur na nges par tshe rtags mi 'byung mi srid 'di nyid la grol bar 'gyur ro// rtsa sna tshogs thams cad 'di la ni shin tu phra na bzang ba yin no// sbom na ngan pa yin no// 'dod chags che ba'i bud med la nges par rtsa bzang po yod zer/ drang dka' thub thabs rnam pa gnyis kyis rang lus thabs ldan dang*/ gzhan bu chung lus shes rab dang ldan pa gnyis ka 'dra'o/ sa mā sti mi thi/ ༈ gnad khyad par can ni/ dbang dus kyi dbang gsum pa dang*/ lam dus kyi pho nya bsten pa gnyis ka la gnad du che ba'i bla ma'i zhal las byung ba 'di yin te/ sbyong ba'i thabs bstan pa/ gzud rlung sems pa'i srang bstan pa/ drang ba'i thabs bstan pa/ dgram pa'i gnas bstan pa'o// de rnams kyi dang po la'ang bzhi ste/

zas la sogs pa ci rigs pa sngon tu song nas/ lus bcos rkang pa g.yon pa g.yas pa'i brla steng du 'khyud pa/ glang po'i rna ba ltar lte ba dang*/ gsang gnas bar du thabs bstan pa/ rlung sems kyi bzung ba'i gnas bstan pa/ dmigs par rlung sngo phyi le ba sor bzhi'am gnyis kyi tshad la dmigs/ bya ba'i (17)yul bstan pa/ rlung nyams btsan thabs su steng 'og rlung kha sbyar des zhag gsum na lte bar 'bur gyis 'ong gsungs/ rlung nyams su blang ba'i man ngag bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la'ang bzhi ste/ pad+ma'i yum bzhi dang sbyar ba'i dus na snal ma ltar phra ba/ mdung gi rtse ltar rno// ral gri'i so ltar gcod/ me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'o 'di lta bu'i bzhi ldan gyi rtsa kun 'dar sbrul gyi mgo rlung gis bskyod pa ltar/ lte ba'i gnas der phrig phrig yong bar bsam/ gsum pa ni mgo smad gzhan bstod de/ dang po a thung du sgra med du drang*/ zhing sgo sprugs/ de nas sgra bcas su drang*/ des 'gre/ mthar yid kyis drang ste/ nges par lus thams cad la khyab pa'i bde ba skye'o// bzhi pa ni steng rlung dgag pa yin te/ dang por lag pa g.yas brkyangs la g.yon gyi dbugs nang du rtag tu rngubs/ sna nas bzung ste mgo sprug /btang ste sprug /yang bzung ste sprug ste/ des nges par ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad thig les khyab par 'gyur ro// de nas lus kyang ras kyi bal gyi zegs ma lta bur 'gyur ro// 'phral du nyams su myong ba skye ba'i phyir/ shin tu'ang gnad che ba yin no// slob dpon ḍom+bi ba'i lam gnyis las/ rtog med bu chung gi lam gyi dang po ngag 'dren pas mdangs sgrub pa sngon tu song nas/ de nas phyag rgya bsten pa la sngon tu rlung sbyang dgos te/ de la'ang sbyong ba/ thig le gzhug pa/ drang ba'i thabs/ dgram pa'i thabs/ dang po la bzhi ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bstan pa/ rlung gzud pa'i gnas// dmigs pa'i yul/

thabs so dang po bsrang*/ gnyis pa ni/ lte ba'i nang nas mar 'bur re byung nas thur du bltas pa dang*/ gshang gci yang 'bur che byung nas kyi bar der/ so gnyis kyi bar/ rlung kha dog sngon po la dmigs pa gtad la/ rlung kha sbyor la bsgom mo// zhag gsum nas de gnyis kyi bar nas gang brtsams la bsgom mo// gzhan yang shes bar bya'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/
